thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> page triggered: GPU_MEM_PRESSURE_PROD (severity: high)
incident-bot: Alert: GPU memory pressure detected on pool=gpu-inference-prod-us-east-1, metric=gpu_mem_used_pct > 92% (5m avg)
pagerduty: PagerDuty note: Incident #PD-84231 fired and routed to on-call (riya).
riya: acked on PD. Looking now. anyone already on-call for pool?
sam: i'm watching console, seeing a wave of short-lived jobs with large sequence lengths. tail latency up ~600ms.
mike: seeing repeated cudaAlloc failures in logs: 
```
2026-02-05T02:12:11Z runtime: cuda: alloc failed: out of memory
stack: runtime/server/exec.go:213
model: gptx-13b-q4
```
riya: thanks mike. can you run a quick `nvidia-smi` on the node set?
mike: pasted output from one node: 
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 530.41.02    Driver Version: 530.41.02    CUDA Version: 12.1 |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0   A100-40GB       Off        | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off |                    0 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  GPU   GI   CI        PID   Type   Process name                        GPU Memory |
|  0     0    0      11234   C     python serving_infer.py                     38120MiB |
|  0     0    0      11257   C     python heavy_preprocessor.py                4196MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
mike: total ~42316MiB used on 40GB card, fragmentation looks bad.
julie: ops-bot shows high kvcache eviction rate for that pool, possible fragmentation + long prefix caches.
riya: immediate mitigation: can we drain new requests to a fallback model variant (gptx-13b-q4-lite) while we investigate? any risk to responses?
sam: routing policy supports fallback. I'll kick a quick route switch for pool=gpu-inference-prod-us-east-1 -> variant=lite, 30% warmup, 70% fallback. Doing now.
sam: route update pushed -> hopefully prevents new heavy allocations. link: https://console.redwood.ai/routing/pools/gpu-inference-prod-us-east-1
mike: initiating proactive eviction on affected nodes: `kubectl exec -n infra nodectrl -- evict-gpu --pool gpu-inference-prod-us-east-1 --max-retry 2`
ops-bot: Eviction command accepted, job id=e145b2. Expect rolling reboots of affected pod(s).
riya: good. Julie, can you surface customer impact? any 5xx spikes or errors seen at API gateway?
julie: API gateway metrics: 5xx increased from baseline 0.12% -> 1.9% in last 6m. Top affected route: /v1/generate-stream (region us-east-1). Estimated affected requests ~3.5k in last 10m, error type mostly 500 cuda alloc.
riya: escalate to PD level 2 if errors don't drop after route switch + evict. mike, how long for evictions to free up usable contiguous memory?
mike: usually immediate for small fragments but reboots may take 90-180s per pod. running `dmesg` shows OOM kill events on some processes earlier: 
```
[367892.123456] Out of memory: Kill process 11234 (python) score 987 or sacrifice child
[367892.123460] python(11234): segfault at 7f...
```
sam: route switch is live. I'm seeing successful fallback spikes, latency stabilized for fallback to ~420ms but quality drop noted by smoke tests.
pagerduty: PD note: riya acknowledged, on-call escalation policy: if 15m pass with >0.5% 5xx, escalate to platform on-call.
riya: I'll hold for 10min and monitor. Mike, please try a targeted compaction on the allocator (if runtime supports).
mike: running compaction: `runtimectl --compact --pool gpu-inference-prod-us-east-1 --target=all`
ops-bot: runtimectl job started: job=compaction-2879990001-1, status=running
mike: compaction returned: freed 3.1GiB fragmented allocations across 6 GPUs. Some nodes still above 88% used.
julie: 5xx rate dropped to 0.7% after compaction + routing. Customer reports: 1 support ticket opened, priority-medium.
riya: good progress. plan: keep fallback in place, continue evictions where needed, add a temporary soft cap on sequence length for that pool to reduce allocation pressure. Sam, can you push seq_len cap?
sam: pushed `--max-seq-len=1024` for pool config; will apply gradually.
mike: monitoring kernel logs for further cuda errors. if we see `cuda: context killed` again we may need full pool restart.
riya: if pool restart needed, coordinate with infra; call it out before restarting so we can do scheduled drain. Julie, update customer channels (status page + ticket).
julie: updating status page: "Degraded performance in us-east-1 for text-generation; fallbacks active; mitigation in progress". ticket updated with mitigation steps and expected next update in 30m.
riya: thanks. i'll keep thread open. timeline: 00:00 root page, +03m route switch, +07m compaction, +12m eviction jobs started. Next update +15m or sooner on escalations.
sam: FYI smoke tests show a small regression in perplexity for lite variant, but user-facing continuity is acceptable for now.
incident-bot: Alert resolved? No — monitoring still in warn state.
riya: marking PD note: will auto-escalate at +15m if 5xx>0.5%. I'll be standing by.
/END OF THREAD
